categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in two segments: coating application and energy systems. The coating application segment includes lithium battery and general semiconductor businesses, covering core components and intelligent equipment. The energy systems segment encompasses energy storage and hydrogen energy businesses, providing energy storage system solutions and hydrogen energy system solutions.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced coating technology engineering applications as its core technology, including high-precision slit coating die heads, ceramic components, and intelligent equipment such as dosing systems and slurry delivery systems. It employs dry electrode manufacturing processes, automated production lines, and MES systems for production management. The company also develops PEM electrolyzers and hydrogen production systems using 3D computational fluid dynamics modeling and vacuum coating technologies for semiconductor and photovoltaic applications.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include lithium battery manufacturers, equipment manufacturers, display enterprises, power grid companies, power generation enterprises, industrial and commercial users, and household users. Major clients in lithium batteries include BYD, CATL, Guoxuan High-Tech, and EVE Energy; in general semiconductors, clients include BOE, Konka Optoelectronics, Trina Solar, Huasheng New Energy, and Extreme Electric; in energy storage, clients include CNNC Hueneng, China Power Construction, Gezhouba Group, and State Energy Group.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with domestic sales accounting for over 98% of revenue. It has established subsidiaries in Germany, Japan, and Hong Kong to support international business expansion, with overseas revenue growing significantly. Key production and R&D bases are located in Shenzhen, Anhui, Huai'an, and other Chinese provinces.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company is positioned as a midstream equipment manufacturer and solution provider within the lithium-ion battery and semiconductor supply chains. It supplies core coating components, intelligent manufacturing equipment, and integrated energy system solutions to downstream manufacturers and end-users.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include platform-based technology development focusing on advanced coating technologies for new energy and general semiconductor industries. R&D efforts emphasize solid-state and dry electrode battery technologies, large-area and flexible perovskite photovoltaic coating equipment, hydrogen energy electrolyzers, and intelligent energy storage systems. The company also invests in automation, digitalization, and robotics, including robotic end-effectors and micro linear actuators.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of coating components, intelligent equipment, energy storage systems, and hydrogen energy solutions. The company also provides customized technical services and system integration solutions, with direct sales as the main marketing approach.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company holds a leading domestic position in high-precision coating die heads for lithium batteries, breaking foreign monopolies and ranking top three globally. It is recognized as a national specialized and innovative 'Little Giant' enterprise with strong R&D capabilities and a growing presence in emerging sectors like perovskite photovoltaics and hydrogen energy. Competitors include other domestic and international equipment manufacturers in lithium battery and semiconductor industries.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.7 billion, representing a 113.7% increase year-over-year, driven mainly by rapid growth in energy systems. However, net profit attributable to shareholders declined by 91.01% to about RMB 30.7 million due to increased expenses, impairment losses, and market uncertainties. Total assets grew by 23.63% to RMB 4.6 billion. The company is in a critical transformation phase expanding into diversified platform businesses.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes advanced coating technology engineering as its core competitive advantage, enabling high-precision, customized, and reliable products that improve battery capacity, safety, and lifespan. It offers integrated, one-stop energy system solutions with high safety and efficiency, supporting green energy transitions. Its products enable import substitution in critical equipment, and it provides strong technical support and after-sales services, fostering long-term customer partnerships and enhancing production efficiency and product quality.
